budget: a guest view in a frame
note: Raised when a frame guest came to be lent the faces the app lends its views (Roadmap f-faces-lent-to-frames): `guestView` and `mountGuestView` take `asset` and `fonts`, the frame's host reads each face within 2 MB and hands it over the port as a data: font (`frameFonts`, in the faces' chunk), and the client puts it in the frame's document. Measured at 2_636 / 1_309 against 1_960 / 981 minified and gzipped.
